name: @growae/reactive-wasm-js-binding
description: WIT world and jco-transpiled JS glue for the differential harness. Not published.

scripts.build:rust: cd placeholder-core && cargo component build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:js: rm -rf generated && mkdir generated && jco transpile placeholder-core/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/core_harness_placeholder.wasm -o generated --name core-harness --minify
scripts.build: pnpm run build:rust && pnpm run build:js
